quests.dispatcherQuestion: A sudden, unforecast snowstorm has stranded over two hundred drivers overnight on a rural highway. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what heavy equipment needs to clear a path first.
quests.explanation: Snowplows must clear a path before any rescue vehicle can reach the stranded drivers at all.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Drivers near the front of the queue are running low on fuel to keep their heaters running. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the two supplies drivers need most right now.
quests.explanation: Fuel keeps heaters running while blankets add warmth, together preventing hypothermia until the road can be cleared.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The road is cleared and all two hundred drivers have safely continued their journeys. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what happens to the emergency operation now.
quests.explanation: Standing the response down once every driver is confirmed safe closes out a long overnight operation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Construction workers have unearthed an unexploded World War Two bomb on a city building site. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the size of the safety zone needed around it.
quests.explanation: A half-mile radius gives enough distance to protect residents if the specialist team needs to detonate it safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The bomb disposal team needs the exact area kept completely clear while they work. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what boundary must be enforced around the site.
quests.explanation: A strict cordon stops anyone from re-entering the area while specialists carefully assess and disarm the device.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The device has been safely removed and transported for controlled disposal elsewhere. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the bomb is safely removed.
quests.explanation: Lifting the zone once the device is fully gone lets thousands of residents return home the same day.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A gas explosion has damaged three adjoining buildings on a city block, with reports of people trapped. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed given three separate buildings are affected.
quests.explanation: Sending a team to each affected building means search efforts happen everywhere at once, not one building at a time.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Gas is still leaking somewhere in the block, and crews cannot locate the exact source. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the wider action needed until the exact source is found.
quests.explanation: Cutting supply to the whole block removes the risk of a second explosion while the leak is traced.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All residents have been accounted for and the gas supply has been safely isolated. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what process should start on the damaged buildings.
quests.explanation: An assessment tells engineers which buildings are safe to re-enter and which need further work.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A large religious festival with an estimated three hundred thousand attendees reports dangerous crowd density near the main shrine. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the crowd management technique that prevents people colliding.
quests.explanation: A one-way flow stops people moving in opposite directions from colliding, which is what usually causes a crowd crush.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Several attendees have fainted in the heat and dense crowd near the shrine entrance. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what facility should be set up nearby.
quests.explanation: A dedicated tent nearby means affected attendees can be treated quickly without being carried far through the crowd.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crowd density has eased as the peak arrival period passes into the evening. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what level of oversight is now appropriate.
quests.explanation: Returning to normal monitoring once the peak has passed frees extra staff while still watching for any change.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A wildfire burning across dry hill country has split into three separate fronts threatening two rural towns. Input code!
quests.hint: Say how firefighting resources should be divided.
quests.explanation: Dividing crews across all three fronts prevents any single one from growing unchecked while the others are fought.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: One front is advancing faster than expected toward the smaller of the two towns. Input code!
quests.hint: Say which town needs to leave first, and why.
quests.explanation: Evacuating the town facing the faster-moving front first gives residents there the most possible time to leave safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Overnight rain has slowed all three fronts, and firefighters report the fire is now contained. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what level of alert now fits the improved conditions.
quests.explanation: Downgrading to a watch reflects the real, improved risk while still keeping residents alert to any change.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A ferry with two hundred passengers reports taking on water after striking a submerged object. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the service that responds to emergencies at sea.
quests.explanation: The coast guard can reach a taking-on-water vessel fastest and coordinate a full passenger rescue if needed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The captain reports pumps are managing the water and the ferry can reach port under its own power. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what support vessels should provide during the journey.
quests.explanation: An escort stays close in case the situation worsens, while letting the ferry make its own way to safety.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The ferry has docked safely and engineers confirm the hull damage was minor. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be confirmed to close out the call.
quests.explanation: A final passenger count confirms the incident is fully resolved before crews stand down.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: An elderly man with dementia has been missing from his care home for six hours as temperatures drop overnight. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what kind of wide search should now begin.
quests.explanation: A coordinated search brings in enough people to cover the wide area he may have wandered into in six hours.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Search teams need to know his last known direction to focus their efforts efficiently. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what evidence can help narrow down the search area.
quests.explanation: Footage from nearby cameras can show which direction he walked, letting the search focus where it matters most.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: He is found safe and warm at a bus shelter a mile from the care home. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen even though he appears unharmed.
quests.explanation: A check-up confirms he wasn't affected by the cold overnight, even though he appears fine on the surface.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A barge has struck the support pillar of a major highway bridge, and engineers fear structural damage. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must happen to the bridge right away.
quests.explanation: Closing the bridge immediately protects every driver on it until the true extent of the damage is known.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Thousands of commuters now need an alternative route while the bridge remains closed. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be provided for stranded commuters.
quests.explanation: A clearly signed alternate route keeps traffic moving through the city while the main bridge is assessed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers complete a full assessment and confirm the pillar can safely support traffic again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the bridge is confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Reopening only after full engineering confirmation ensures commuters return to a bridge that's genuinely sound.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A severe flu outbreak has filled every hospital in the region to capacity within the same week. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the pre-prepared plan hospitals use for exactly this.
quests.explanation: A surge plan coordinates beds, staff, and supplies across every hospital in the region at once, rather than each acting alone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: One smaller hospital has more spare capacity than the others and can take extra patients. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen given the spare capacity found.
quests.explanation: Redirecting patients to the hospital with spare capacity balances the load across the whole region fairly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: New flu cases have started to fall and all regional hospitals report manageable numbers again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the emergency plan now.
quests.explanation: Standing the plan down once numbers are manageable returns hospitals to their normal way of working.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A temporary stage at an outdoor festival has partially collapsed under high winds during a performance. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to people near the stage.
quests.explanation: Clearing the area protects both performers and crowd from any further part of the structure coming down.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Structural engineers need to check whether the rest of the scaffolding is safe before anyone approaches. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the specialist trained to judge this.
quests.explanation: Only a structural engineer can properly judge whether the remaining scaffolding is safe to work near.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Two crew members with minor injuries have been treated, and no one else was hurt. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for staff trained to treat minor injuries.
quests.explanation: On-site first aid staff can treat minor injuries quickly without needing a full ambulance response.
